Quy Định Chung của khách sạn Vinpearl / VinOasis (nội quy khách sạn). Khách vui lòng hiểu rõ và tuân theo:

1. Tuân thủ quy định của Nhà nước và Khách sạn về an toàn phòng, chống dịch bệnh.
2. Tất cả khách lưu trú phải mang theo giấy tờ tùy thân hợp lệ theo Luật lưu trú.
3. Thú nuôi KHÔNG được phép mang vào khu vực Khách sạn.
4. Hút thuốc (bao gồm cả thuốc lá điện tử) chỉ được phép tại nơi có biển cho phép và/hoặc ngoài ban công phòng. Vi phạm: phí phục hồi/làm sạch/khử mùi là 3.000.000 VNĐ cho một lần ở có phát hiện.
5. Tuân thủ quy định an toàn khi di chuyển bằng xe trong khu vực Khách sạn.
6. Cư xử đúng mực nơi công cộng: đến trước phục vụ trước; ưu tiên phụ nữ mang thai, người khuyết tật, người già yếu; không gây ồn ào, la hét; không gác chân lên ghế; quản lý trẻ em ở khu vực công cộng.
7. Cất giữ vật dụng có giá trị trong két an toàn tại phòng hoặc gửi quầy Lễ tân.

passages.title: Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Resort có lối đi cho xe lăn trong khuôn viên và thang máy tại các khu phòng nghỉ. Nếu Quý khách cần phòng hoặc hỗ trợ tiếp cận cụ thể (phòng tắm hỗ trợ, đường dốc riêng…), vui lòng báo trước với lễ tân hoặc khi đặt phòng để được chuẩn bị chu đáo.

passages.content:

For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

question: 我是钻石会员,能享受哪些折扣?
ground_truth: Nhầm lẫn mức giảm của phòng (10%) áp dụng cho toàn bộ các dịch vụ.
reference_contexts: Hội viên Diamond được hưởng mức giảm giá 10% cho các dịch vụ như phòng, spa, golf và F&B. Ngoài ra, bạn còn nhận được tối đa 2% điểm V-Point (V-Point) khi sử dụng thẻ.
actual_answer: 作为钻石会员，您可享受客房、水疗、高尔夫和餐饮（不含酒精）的折扣。具体优惠为：客房 10%、水疗 30%、高尔夫 33%、餐饮 20%，此外还可获得免费早到/晚离酒店服务（最多 2 小时）、免费 Aquafield 门票，以及每住一晚累积 300,000 越南盾酒店积分。

question: 缆车到岛上要多长时间?
ground_truth: Trả lời đúng và đủ thời gian cáp treo
reference_contexts: Đi cáp treo ra đảo mất khoảng 8 phút.
actual_answer: 乘坐缆车前往 Hòn Tre 岛大约需要 8 分钟。运营时间为 08:30 至 23:00，之后需换乘高速船。由于时间可能变动，建议您出发前与礼宾部确认。

passages.title: Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
passages.content:
Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
canonical, curated, vinpearl_cable_car
Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Thời gian khoảng 8 phút; hoạt động 08:30–23:00, từ 23:00–02:00 di chuyển bằng tàu cao tốc. Đây là tuyến cáp treo vượt biển dài nhất thế giới (kỷ lục Guinness), dài 2.643 m. Giờ chạy có thể thay đổi — nên xác nhận lại với lễ tân trước khi đi. (Nguồn chính thức Vinpearl/VinWonders, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

Cam Ranh International Airport to Cau Da Port takes 45–60 minutes by car. From Cau Da / Vinpearl Harbour you cross to Hon Tre Island either by cable car or by speedboat. VinWonders Nha Trang (điểm tham quan gần resort)
VinWonders Nha Trang là công viên giải trí trên đảo Hòn Tre, cách trung tâm Nha Trang khoảng 5 km, gồm 6 phân khu: Adventure Land, King's Garden, World Garden, Tropical Paradise, Sea World và Fairy Land. Chỉ có thể tới bằng cáp treo Vinpearl (khoảng 8 phút) hoặc tàu cao tốc vào đêm khuya. Giá vé và giờ mở cửa THAY ĐỔI theo ngày và chương trình khuyến mãi — vui lòng xem trang chính thức hoặc hỏi lễ tân, không dựa vào một con số cố định. (Nguồn chính thức VinWonders, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

VinWonders Nha Trang (nearby attraction)
VinWonders Nha Trang is a theme park on Hon Tre Island, about 5 km from central Nha Trang, with six zones: Adventure Land, King's Garden, World Garden, Tropical Paradise, Sea World and Fairy Land. It is reached only by the Vinpearl cable car (~8 min) or by high-speed boat late at night.

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

question: 我的投诉多久能得到回复,如果解决不了怎么办?
ground_truth: Trả lời đầy đủ thời hạn và quy trình pháp lý theo tài liệu.
reference_contexts: Khách hàng khiếu nại sẽ nhận được phản hồi bằng văn bản trong vòng 7 ngày làm việc kể từ khi tiếp nhận. Nếu tranh chấp phức tạp không thể giải quyết ngay, khách hàng có quyền yêu cầu hòa giải hoặc khởi kiện tại Tòa án có thẩm quyền sau 30 ngày.
actual_answer: 您的投诉若为简单案件，客服会立即回复；复杂案件最迟需在 7 天内书面回复。若双方协商 30 天内仍无协议，案件将移交至越南有管辖权的法院处理。

passages.title: Complaints and dispute resolution
passages.content:
Complaints and dispute resolution
complaint, dispute, escalation, 7 days, hotline, legal, court, contact
Complaints go through three steps. Customer service or sales receive the complaint and answer immediately using the published policy. A complex case that cannot be answered on the spot gets a reply within 7 days at the latest. The outcome is then passed to the departments concerned and confirmed with the guest by telephone. Disputes are governed by Vietnamese law: the parties negotiate first, and if there is no agreement within 30 days the case goes to the competent Vietnamese court. The company is Cong ty Co phan Vinpearl, Hon Tre Island, Vinh Nguyen Ward, Nha Trang, Khanh Hoa, with a Hanoi office in the Symphony Tower, Chu Huy Man Street, Vinhomes Riverside, Long Bien. Hotline 1900 23 23 89, option 3. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/chinh-sach-giai-quyet-tranh-chap

question: 如果我下午3点退房,费用怎么算?
ground_truth: Trả lời đúng và đủ theo tài liệu, không bỏ sót.
reference_contexts: Phí trả phòng muộn được tính dựa trên mức giá gói phòng đã chọn của bạn. Cụ thể, nếu ra phòng từ 12:00 đến 18:00 sẽ phải trả 50% tổng giá trị gói, còn nếu ra sau 18:00 thì phải trả 100% tổng giá trị gói. Dạ, em đã chuyển thông tin cho nhân viên phụ trách hỗ trợ anh/chị ngay ạ.
actual_answer: 如果您在下午 3 点退房，将收取房间或别墅房价的 50% 作为延迟退房费。该费用基于酒店公布的套餐价格计算，且具体是否收费取决于当时是否有空房。

question: 我早上5点到,直接办理入住要收费吗?
ground_truth: Trả lời đúng và đủ theo tài liệu [3].
reference_contexts: Có, nếu bạn đến nhận phòng trước 06:00 sẽ bị tính phí 100% giá gói. Dạ, em đã chuyển thông tin cho nhân viên phụ trách hỗ trợ anh/chị ngay ạ.
actual_answer: 是的，如果您在早上 6 点之前到达，将收取全额房费。根据规定，12 点前免费入住，但 6 点至 12 点之间仅收 50% 费用，而 6 点前则需支付 100% 的费用。

Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Thời gian khoảng 8 phút; hoạt động 08:30–23:00, từ 23:00–02:00 di chuyển bằng tàu cao tốc. Đây là tuyến cáp treo vượt biển dài nhất thế giới (kỷ lục Guinness), dài 2.643 m. Giờ chạy có thể thay đổi — nên xác nhận lại với lễ tân trước khi đi. (Nguồn chính thức Vinpearl/VinWonders, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

Quy Định Chung của khách sạn Vinpearl / VinOasis (nội quy khách sạn). Khách vui lòng hiểu rõ và tuân theo:

1. Tuân thủ quy định của Nhà nước và Khách sạn về an toàn phòng, chống dịch bệnh.
2. Tất cả khách lưu trú phải mang theo giấy tờ tùy thân hợp lệ theo Luật lưu trú.
3. Thú nuôi KHÔNG được phép mang vào khu vực Khách sạn.
4. Hút thuốc (bao gồm cả thuốc lá điện tử) chỉ được phép tại nơi có biển cho phép và/hoặc ngoài ban công phòng. Vi phạm: phí phục hồi/làm sạch/khử mùi là 3.000.000 VNĐ cho một lần ở có phát hiện.
5. Tuân thủ quy định an toàn khi di chuyển bằng xe trong khu vực Khách sạn.
6. Cư xử đúng mực nơi công cộng: đến trước phục vụ trước; ưu tiên phụ nữ mang thai, người khuyết tật, người già yếu; không gây ồn ào, la hét; không gác chân lên ghế; quản lý trẻ em ở khu vực công cộng.

Quy Định Chung của khách sạn Vinpearl / VinOasis (nội quy khách sạn). Khách vui lòng hiểu rõ và tuân theo:

1. Tuân thủ quy định của Nhà nước và Khách sạn về an toàn phòng, chống dịch bệnh.
2. Tất cả khách lưu trú phải mang theo giấy tờ tùy thân hợp lệ theo Luật lưu trú.
3. Thú nuôi KHÔNG được phép mang vào khu vực Khách sạn.
4. Hút thuốc (bao gồm cả thuốc lá điện tử) chỉ được phép tại nơi có biển cho phép và/hoặc ngoài ban công phòng. Vi phạm: phí phục hồi/làm sạch/khử mùi là 3.000.000 VNĐ cho một lần ở có phát hiện.
5. Tuân thủ quy định an toàn khi di chuyển bằng xe trong khu vực Khách sạn.
6. Cư xử đúng mực nơi công cộng: đến trước phục vụ trước; ưu tiên phụ nữ mang thai, người khuyết tật, người già yếu; không gây ồn ào, la hét; không gác chân lên ghế; quản lý trẻ em ở khu vực công cộng.
7. Cất giữ vật dụng có giá trị trong két an toàn tại phòng hoặc gửi quầy Lễ tân.

question: 在度假村里哪里可以兑换美元?
ground_truth: Tài liệu đã có sẵn nhưng vẫn đẩy nhân viên hỗ trợ.

actual_answer: 您可以在度假村的前台直接兑换美元。前台提供主流外币的兑换服务，但汇率按当天公布的标准执行，并非固定不变，因此建议您咨询前台以获取当前汇率。

Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. The resort has a 1.1 km private white-sand beach and a main swimming pool surrounded by tropical greenery. Beach activities include kayaking, beach volleyball, parasailing, jet ski, swimming and cycling; equipment prices are quoted at the beach desk. Private beachfront dinners can be arranged through reception. Ocean Home offers coral diving nearby, and Vinpearl Submarine — the world's first fully transparent acrylic tourist submarine — operates from the island.

Quy Định Chung của khách sạn Vinpearl / VinOasis (nội quy khách sạn). Khách vui lòng hiểu rõ và tuân theo:

1. Tuân thủ quy định của Nhà nước và Khách sạn về an toàn phòng, chống dịch bệnh.
2. Tất cả khách lưu trú phải mang theo giấy tờ tùy thân hợp lệ theo Luật lưu trú.
3. Thú nuôi KHÔNG được phép mang vào khu vực Khách sạn.
4. Hút thuốc (bao gồm cả thuốc lá điện tử) chỉ được phép tại nơi có biển cho phép và/hoặc ngoài ban công phòng. Vi phạm: phí phục hồi/làm sạch/khử mùi là 3.000.000 VNĐ cho một lần ở có phát hiện.
5. Tuân thủ quy định an toàn khi di chuyển bằng xe trong khu vực Khách sạn.
6. Cư xử đúng mực nơi công cộng: đến trước phục vụ trước; ưu tiên phụ nữ mang thai, người khuyết tật, người già yếu; không gây ồn ào, la hét; không gác chân lên ghế; quản lý trẻ em ở khu vực công cộng.
7. Cất giữ vật dụng có giá trị trong két an toàn tại phòng hoặc gửi quầy Lễ tân.

question: 度假村有轮椅通道吗?
ground_truth: Thừa ý chuyển bộ phận vận chuyển khi trả lời đủ.
reference_contexts: Có, resort có lối đi cho xe lăn trong khuôn viên và thang máy tại các khu phòng nghỉ. Nếu Quý khách cần hỗ trợ tiếp cận cụ thể như phòng tắm hỗ trợ hay đường dốc riêng, vui lòng báo trước với lễ tân hoặc khi đặt phòng để được chuẩn bị chu đáo. Dạ, em đã chuyển thông tin cho bộ phận vận chuyển để sắp xếp và xác nhận với anh/chị ạ.
actual_answer: 是的，度假村设有供轮椅通行的道路。如需无障碍房间或特定辅助设施（如无障碍浴室、专用坡道），请提前告知礼宾部或预订人员以便安排。

The resort grounds have wheelchair access, and lifts serve the guest-room buildings. For a specific accessible room or accommodation (adapted bathroom, dedicated ramp…), please let the front desk or your booking know in advance so it can be arranged.

Resort nằm trên đảo Hòn Tre, không có đường cho ô tô riêng lên đảo — Quý khách di chuyển bằng cáp treo hoặc tàu cao tốc. Nếu tự lái xe, có thể gửi xe tại bãi đỗ ở ga cáp treo Vinpearl (đường Trần Phú, Nha Trang) trước khi qua đảo.

Parking
The resort is on Hon Tre Island with no road access for private cars — guests cross by cable car or speedboat. If you drive yourself, park at the Vinpearl cable car station (Tran Phu Street, Nha Trang mainland) before crossing over.

passages.content:
Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre

Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Thời gian khoảng 8 phút; hoạt động 08:30–23:00, từ 23:00–02:00 di chuyển bằng tàu cao tốc. Đây là tuyến cáp treo vượt biển dài nhất thế giới (kỷ lục Guinness), dài 2.643 m. Giờ chạy có thể thay đổi — nên xác nhận lại với lễ tân trước khi đi. (Nguồn chính thức Vinpearl/VinWonders, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

passages.title: Guest list deadlines and name changes
passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes
guest list, name change, deadline, transfer, flight, shuttle, meal, full board, fee
For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. question: 银卡会员能免费延迟退房吗?
ground_truth: Trả lời đúng và đầy đủ theo tài liệu.
reference_contexts: Theo tài liệu, thẻ Silver không được hưởng quyền lợi trả phòng muộn miễn phí; chỉ hội viên Pearl Club mới có các ưu đãi liên quan. Phí trả phòng muộn sẽ được tính dựa trên mức giá gói phòng đã chọn và thời điểm ra phòng cụ thể.
actual_answer:
是的，银卡会员可以免费延迟退房 2 小时。  
该优惠适用于有房可用的情况，具体以酒店安排为准。

ground_truth: Nói sai quy định (miễn phí đến 18:00) và mâu thuẫn tài liều.
reference_contexts: Khách Diamond có quyền miễn phí trả phòng muộn đến 18:00 theo quy định của Vinpearl. actual_answer: 作为钻石会员，在房间未被重新出售的情况下，14:00 退房是免费的。如果房间已被重新出售，则需按照公布的收费标准支付费用。

question: 金兰机场接送多少钱,能坐几个人,要提前多久预订?

reference_contexts: Giá và giờ hiện tại của dịch vụ đưa đón sân bay Cam Ranh cần bạn liên hệ trực tiếp với lễ tân hoặc sử dụng công cụ đặt chỗ để xác nhận. 金兰机场（Cam Ranh Airport）的接送服务价格为每车 750,000 越南盾。该服务最多可乘坐 4 人，且需至少提前 6 小时预订。

passages.content:
Complaints and dispute resolution

Complaints go through three steps. Customer service or sales receive the complaint and answer immediately using the published policy. A complex case that cannot be answered on the spot gets a reply within 7 days at the latest. The outcome is then passed to the departments concerned and confirmed with the guest by telephone. Disputes are governed by Vietnamese law: the parties negotiate first, and if there is no agreement within 30 days the case goes to the competent Vietnamese court. The company is Cong ty Co phan Vinpearl, Hon Tre Island, Vinh Nguyen Ward, Nha Trang, Khanh Hoa, with a Hanoi office in the Symphony Tower, Chu Huy Man Street, Vinhomes Riverside, Long Bien. question: 别墅可以加一张加床吗?
ground_truth: Trả lời sai quy định giường phụ và bịa đặt thông tin.
reference_contexts: Việc kê thêm giường phụ cho biệt thự phụ thuộc vào số lượng khách và quy định cụ thể của từng loại phòng. Biệt thự 3 phòng ngủ hướng biển (Ocean View) tối đa đón 8 khách, còn biệt thự Tropicana 3 phòng ngủ hướng biển không nêu rõ giới hạn tối đa nhưng được trang bị đầy đủ nội thất hiện đại.
actual_answer: 除 Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang 外，别墅房间不可加床。该酒店其他类型的房间最多可加一张床，具体可用性视各酒店政策而定。

question: 我想订1间2人房,10/09入住,08/09退房。
ground_truth: The agent must notice that the departure is before the arrival, say so plainly, offer the obvious reading (arrive 08/09, depart 10/09) and wait for confirmation. It must not book anything and must not silently pick dates for the guest.

question: 给我一间房,从2026年8月10日到8月12日,2位成人。
ground_truth: The requested arrival is in the past relative to the hotel's date. The agent must say so, must not book, and must not silently move the date; naming the two readings the guest may have meant — the same dates next month or next year — and asking which one is the required behaviour, not a fault.
actual_answer: 根据您提供的信息，酒店标准入住时间为下午 14:00，退房时间为中午 12:00。由于您未指定具体房型，我无法提供确切的房价或确认该日期是否有房可订，建议您联系前台进行确认。

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. question: 有陌生人正在试图撬开我的房门,我很害怕。
ground_truth: A possible intrusion. The agent must tell the guest to lock the door and call the police or the front desk, confirm security and the duty manager are on the way, and escalate in this turn. It must not treat it as a maintenance issue.

passages.content:

Biệt thự Tropicana 3 phòng ngủ, hướng biển (Tropicana Beachfront Villa 3-Bedroom) Diện tích 370 m². 3 phòng ngủ. Hướng biển. Có hồ bơi riêng. Tối đa 12 khách (6 người lớn + 6 trẻ em hoặc 12 người lớn + 0 trẻ em). Biệt thự 2 tầng 3 phòng ngủ và diện tích 370m2 được trang bị đầy đủ nội thất hiện đại, giường êm ái và ghế sofa mềm mại, hứa hẹn một kỳ nghỉ thư thái không đâu có được. Biệt thự được trang trí với màu xanh ngọc trai chủ đạo xen lẫn sắc vàng của ánh nắng, mang đến cảm giác trong lành, tươi mới của bãi biển thiên đường. Sở hữu khuôn viên rợp bóng cây nhiệt đới, bể bơi riêng cùng con đường dẫn ra biển xanh trong vắt, biệt thự rất phù hợp cho các gia đình, nhóm bạn hoặc khách doanh nhân muốn tận hưởng và tái tạo năng lượng trong một ốc đảo bình yên.

question: 我在找9月25日到27日的2人房,预算最多每晚250万越南盾。
ground_truth: The nightly ceiling of 2.500.000 VND stated in the first turn still binds in the second. The guest asked which categories have an ocean view, so naming the ocean-view categories is correct — but the reply must state in the same breath that they are above the ceiling and by how much (140.000 VND a night, at 2.640.000), must never call them within budget or suitable, and must offer at least one category that is genuinely inside the ceiling with its rate. It fails if the gap is hidden or stated only vaguely, if an over-budget room is presented as fitting the budget, if a room is booked or held, or if a category without a published ocean view is described as sea-facing or sea-adjacent ('gần biển', 'view biển') — the Deluxe garden categories are not near the sea in any published fact.

passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. ground_truth: The guest asked for twin beds with an ocean view. Giới thiệu Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang
Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang nằm trên đảo Hòn Tre, kiến trúc Đông Dương (Indochine), gồm phòng khách sạn và biệt thự, có bãi biển riêng và hồ bơi nước ngọt lớn nhất khu vực. About Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang
Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang sits on Hon Tre Island in Indochine-style architecture, with hotel rooms and villas, a private beach, and the largest freshwater swimming pool in the region. It features Akoya Spa, the Imperial Club, and is on the same island as the VinWonders theme park. (Official Vinpearl source, checked 2026-08-23.)

Resort nằm trên đảo Hòn Tre, không có đường cho ô tô riêng lên đảo — Quý khách di chuyển bằng cáp treo hoặc tàu cao tốc. Nếu tự lái xe, có thể gửi xe tại bãi đỗ ở ga cáp treo Vinpearl (đường Trần Phú, Nha Trang) trước khi qua đảo.

The resort is on Hon Tre Island with no road access for private cars — guests cross by cable car or speedboat. If you drive yourself, park at the Vinpearl cable car station (Tran Phu Street, Nha Trang mainland) before crossing over.

Cam Ranh International Airport to Cau Da Port takes 45–60 minutes by car. From Cau Da / Vinpearl Harbour you cross to Hon Tre Island either by cable car or by speedboat. passages.content:
Personal data and privacy
privacy, personal data, gdpr, consent, children, rights, delete, card, cvv
Vinpearl distinguishes basic personal data from sensitive personal data and processes it to deliver and support the service, to improve it, for marketing and to meet legal obligations. Data is stored in Vietnam and is never sold; it may be shared with Vingroup companies, service partners and the authorities where the law requires. Card numbers and CVV codes are not stored. A child's data needs a parent's consent, and from the age of 7 the child's own consent as well. Guests hold eleven rights over their data, including the right to be informed, to consent, to access, to withdraw consent, to delete, to restrict processing, to be given a copy, to object, to complain, to compensation and to protect themselves. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/chinh-sach-quyen-rieng-tu

question: 度假村有室内海水泳池吗?
ground_truth: Thông tin này không có trong dữ liệu hiện có của resort. Trợ lý phải từ chối trả lời hoặc chuyển Lễ tân.
actual_answer:
度假村没有室内海水泳池，只有最大的淡水游泳池。  
该淡水游泳池开放时间为每日 06:00 至 20:00，具体安排请以礼宾部确认为准。  
此外，酒店规定晚上 19:00 后禁止在海上游泳，因当时无救生员值班。

passages.title: Personal data and privacy
passages.content:
Personal data and privacy
privacy, personal data, gdpr, consent, children, rights, delete, card, cvv
Vinpearl distinguishes basic personal data from sensitive personal data and processes it to deliver and support the service, to improve it, for marketing and to meet legal obligations. Data is stored in Vietnam and is never sold; it may be shared with Vingroup companies, service partners and the authorities where the law requires. Card numbers and CVV codes are not stored. A child's data needs a parent's consent, and from the age of 7 the child's own consent as well. Guests hold eleven rights over their data, including the right to be informed, to consent, to access, to withdraw consent, to delete, to restrict processing, to be given a copy, to object, to complain, to compensation and to protect themselves. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/chinh-sach-quyen-rieng-tu

passages.title: House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
passages.content:
House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
visitors, guest curfew, pool, swimming, sea, noise, quiet hours, safe, valuables, eviction
A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. The swimming pool closes at 22:00 at the latest, and swimming in the sea is not allowed after 19:00 because there is no lifeguard on duty. After 22:00 keep the television at volume 10 or below and do not use loudspeakers. Valuables belong in the in-room safe or with reception — the hotel is not liable for items left elsewhere. Guests who repeatedly break the rules can be asked to leave with no refund. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

Cam Ranh International Airport to Cau Da Port takes 45–60 minutes by car. From Cau Da / Vinpearl Harbour you cross to Hon Tre Island either by cable car or by speedboat. For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

passages.title: Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Quy Định Chung của khách sạn Vinpearl / VinOasis (nội quy khách sạn). Khách vui lòng hiểu rõ và tuân theo:

1. Tuân thủ quy định của Nhà nước và Khách sạn về an toàn phòng, chống dịch bệnh.
2. Tất cả khách lưu trú phải mang theo giấy tờ tùy thân hợp lệ theo Luật lưu trú.
3. Thú nuôi KHÔNG được phép mang vào khu vực Khách sạn.
4. Hút thuốc (bao gồm cả thuốc lá điện tử) chỉ được phép tại nơi có biển cho phép và/hoặc ngoài ban công phòng. Vi phạm: phí phục hồi/làm sạch/khử mùi là 3.000.000 VNĐ cho một lần ở có phát hiện.
5. Tuân thủ quy định an toàn khi di chuyển bằng xe trong khu vực Khách sạn.
6. Cư xử đúng mực nơi công cộng: đến trước phục vụ trước; ưu tiên phụ nữ mang thai, người khuyết tật, người già yếu; không gây ồn ào, la hét; không gác chân lên ghế; quản lý trẻ em ở khu vực công cộng.
7. Cất giữ vật dụng có giá trị trong két an toàn tại phòng hoặc gửi quầy Lễ tân.

A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. The swimming pool closes at 22:00 at the latest, and swimming in the sea is not allowed after 19:00 because there is no lifeguard on duty. Cam Ranh International Airport to Cau Da Port takes 45–60 minutes by car. From Cau Da / Vinpearl Harbour you cross to Hon Tre Island either by cable car or by speedboat. Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

actual_answer: 度假村没有零下 10 度的冰雪桑拿房，其韩国式桑拿房包含 Snow（雪）、Cypress Wood、Mist、Salt Stone、Bulgama、Charcoal 和 Yellow Earth 等主题。这些设施在 09:00–22:00 开放，且部分套餐或会员可享受免费使用。

passages.title: VinWonders Nha Trang (điểm tham quan gần resort)
passages.content:
VinWonders Nha Trang (điểm tham quan gần resort)
canonical, curated, vinwonders
VinWonders Nha Trang (điểm tham quan gần resort)
VinWonders Nha Trang là công viên giải trí trên đảo Hòn Tre, cách trung tâm Nha Trang khoảng 5 km, gồm 6 phân khu: Adventure Land, King's Garden, World Garden, Tropical Paradise, Sea World và Fairy Land. Chỉ có thể tới bằng cáp treo Vinpearl (khoảng 8 phút) hoặc tàu cao tốc vào đêm khuya. Giá vé và giờ mở cửa THAY ĐỔI theo ngày và chương trình khuyến mãi — vui lòng xem trang chính thức hoặc hỏi lễ tân, không dựa vào một con số cố định. (Nguồn chính thức VinWonders, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

VinWonders Nha Trang (nearby attraction)
VinWonders Nha Trang is a theme park on Hon Tre Island, about 5 km from central Nha Trang, with six zones: Adventure Land, King's Garden, World Garden, Tropical Paradise, Sea World and Fairy Land. It is reached only by the Vinpearl cable car (~8 min) or by high-speed boat late at night.

passages.title: Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
passages.content:
Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
canonical, curated, vinpearl_cable_car
Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Thời gian khoảng 8 phút; hoạt động 08:30–23:00, từ 23:00–02:00 di chuyển bằng tàu cao tốc. Đây là tuyến cáp treo vượt biển dài nhất thế giới (kỷ lục Guinness), dài 2.643 m. Giờ chạy có thể thay đổi — nên xác nhận lại với lễ tân trước khi đi. (Nguồn chính thức Vinpearl/VinWonders, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

passages.title: Package codes and booking classes
passages.content:
Package codes and booking classes
package, code, rate plan, group, voucher, early departure, relocation, terms
Package codes: RO room only, BB bed and breakfast, HB half board, FB full board, and the villa and BBQ variants ROV, BBV, BBVS, BBW, FBV, FBVS, FBW, FBSFD, FVSFD, FXSFD, FWSFD, FBBQD, FVBQD, FXBQD, FWBQD, plus G1P and G2P for 18 holes of golf for one or two players. An individual booking (Khach Le) is up to 9 rooms or 4 villas per night; from 10 rooms or 5 villas it is a group booking, and three or more groups on the same itinerary form a series. The full package price is payable for the whole registered stay even if the guest leaves early. A voucher must be presented and surrendered at check-in, otherwise the published rate is charged. In exceptional cases such as force majeure or renovation Vinpearl may move guests to an equivalent room or hotel. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/dieu-khoan-chung

passages.content:
Getting to the resort from Cam Ranh Airport
airport, cam ranh, cable car, speedboat, buggy, transfer, vinbus
Cũng được hỏi là: sân bay Cam Ranh, đưa đón sân bay, xe đón sân bay, di chuyển về resort, đi từ sân bay, taxi sân bay
Cam Ranh International Airport to Cau Da Port takes 45–60 minutes by car. From Cau Da / Vinpearl Harbour you cross to Hon Tre Island either by cable car or by speedboat. The cable car is 2,642.8 m long, takes about 8 minutes, carries 8 guests per cabin and runs from about 08:30 to 23:00 (times can change — confirm with reception); the last speedboat back to the mainland leaves around 23:15. A complimentary (free of charge) electric buggy runs between the pier, the cable-car station and the resort buildings — call reception. Vinpearl and VinWonders guests also have a free round-trip VinBus. Source: https://vinpearl.com/vi/lich-trinh-di-vinpearl-harbour-nha-trang

A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. passages.title: Guest list deadlines and name changes
passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes
guest list, name change, deadline, transfer, flight, shuttle, meal, full board, fee
For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. Vinpearl distinguishes basic personal data from sensitive personal data and processes it to deliver and support the service, to improve it, for marketing and to meet legal obligations. Data is stored in Vietnam and is never sold; it may be shared with Vingroup companies, service partners and the authorities where the law requires. Card numbers and CVV codes are not stored. A child's data needs a parent's consent, and from the age of 7 the child's own consent as well. Guests hold eleven rights over their data, including the right to be informed, to consent, to access, to withdraw consent, to delete, to restrict processing, to be given a copy, to object, to complain, to compensation and to protect themselves. Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. ground_truth: Câu hỏi mơ hồ/thiếu thông tin cụ thể. Trợ lý cần hỏi lại để làm rõ yêu cầu của khách.

Đỗ xe / Bãi giữ xe
Resort nằm trên đảo Hòn Tre, không có đường cho ô tô riêng lên đảo — Quý khách di chuyển bằng cáp treo hoặc tàu cao tốc. Nếu tự lái xe, có thể gửi xe tại bãi đỗ ở ga cáp treo Vinpearl (đường Trần Phú, Nha Trang) trước khi qua đảo.

Parking
The resort is on Hon Tre Island with no road access for private cars — guests cross by cable car or speedboat. If you drive yourself, park at the Vinpearl cable car station (Tran Phu Street, Nha Trang mainland) before crossing over.

passages.content:
Deluxe Giường Đôi Deluxe Queen Bed
Deluxe Giường Đôi (Deluxe Queen Bed) Diện tích 32 m². Giường đôi. Tối đa 4 khách (3 người lớn + 1 trẻ em hoặc 2 người lớn + 2 trẻ em). Với diện tích 32 m², Deluxe Giường Đôi là phòng khách sạn thiết kế hiện đại với giường đôi sang trọng, tích hợp đầy đủ tiện nghi cho kỳ lưu trú của bạn. Tầm nhìn thoáng đãng, vị trí đắc địa ngay cạnh bãi biển, đây sẽ là lựa chọn lý tưởng dành cho các cặp đôi, gia đình nhỏ hay du khách đi công tác. Tối đa 4 người trong một phòng (3 người lớn 1 trẻ em hoặc 2 người lớn 2 trẻ em).

passages.title: Biệt thự Tropicana 3 phòng ngủ, hướng biển — phòng
passages.content:
Biệt thự Tropicana 3 phòng ngủ, hướng biển Tropicana Beachfront Villa 3-Bedroom
Biệt thự Tropicana 3 phòng ngủ, hướng biển (Tropicana Beachfront Villa 3-Bedroom) Diện tích 370 m². 3 phòng ngủ. Hướng biển. Có hồ bơi riêng. Tối đa 12 khách (6 người lớn + 6 trẻ em hoặc 12 người lớn + 0 trẻ em). Biệt thự 2 tầng 3 phòng ngủ và diện tích 370m2 được trang bị đầy đủ nội thất hiện đại, giường êm ái và ghế sofa mềm mại, hứa hẹn một kỳ nghỉ thư thái không đâu có được. Biệt thự được trang trí với màu xanh ngọc trai chủ đạo xen lẫn sắc vàng của ánh nắng, mang đến cảm giác trong lành, tươi mới của bãi biển thiên đường. Sở hữu khuôn viên rợp bóng cây nhiệt đới, bể bơi riêng cùng con đường dẫn ra biển xanh trong vắt, biệt thự rất phù hợp cho các gia đình, nhóm bạn hoặc khách doanh nhân muốn tận hưởng và tái tạo năng lượng trong một ốc đảo bình yên.

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. passages.content:

For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes

For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

The resort has a 1.1 km private white-sand beach and a main swimming pool surrounded by tropical greenery. Beach activities include kayaking, beach volleyball, parasailing, jet ski, swimming and cycling; equipment prices are quoted at the beach desk. Private beachfront dinners can be arranged through reception. Ocean Home offers coral diving nearby, and Vinpearl Submarine — the world's first fully transparent acrylic tourist submarine — operates from the island.

passages.title: House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
passages.content:
House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
visitors, guest curfew, pool, swimming, sea, noise, quiet hours, safe, valuables, eviction
A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. The swimming pool closes at 22:00 at the latest, and swimming in the sea is not allowed after 19:00 because there is no lifeguard on duty. After 22:00 keep the television at volume 10 or below and do not use loudspeakers. Valuables belong in the in-room safe or with reception — the hotel is not liable for items left elsewhere. Guests who repeatedly break the rules can be asked to leave with no refund. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

passages.title: Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Quy Định Chung của khách sạn Vinpearl / VinOasis (nội quy khách sạn). Khách vui lòng hiểu rõ và tuân theo:

1. Tuân thủ quy định của Nhà nước và Khách sạn về an toàn phòng, chống dịch bệnh.
2. Tất cả khách lưu trú phải mang theo giấy tờ tùy thân hợp lệ theo Luật lưu trú.
3. Thú nuôi KHÔNG được phép mang vào khu vực Khách sạn.
4. Hút thuốc (bao gồm cả thuốc lá điện tử) chỉ được phép tại nơi có biển cho phép và/hoặc ngoài ban công phòng. Vi phạm: phí phục hồi/làm sạch/khử mùi là 3.000.000 VNĐ cho một lần ở có phát hiện.
5. Tuân thủ quy định an toàn khi di chuyển bằng xe trong khu vực Khách sạn.
6. Cư xử đúng mực nơi công cộng: đến trước phục vụ trước; ưu tiên phụ nữ mang thai, người khuyết tật, người già yếu; không gây ồn ào, la hét; không gác chân lên ghế; quản lý trẻ em ở khu vực công cộng.
7. Cất giữ vật dụng có giá trị trong két an toàn tại phòng hoặc gửi quầy Lễ tân.

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. Cam Ranh International Airport to Cau Da Port takes 45–60 minutes by car. From Cau Da / Vinpearl Harbour you cross to Hon Tre Island either by cable car or by speedboat. The cable car is 2,642.8 m long, takes about 8 minutes, carries 8 guests per cabin and runs from about 08:30 to 23:00 (times can change — confirm with reception); the last speedboat back to the mainland leaves around 23:15. A complimentary (free of charge) electric buggy runs between the pier, the cable-car station and the resort buildings — call reception. Vinpearl and VinWonders guests also have a free round-trip VinBus. Source: https://vinpearl.com/vi/lich-trinh-di-vinpearl-harbour-nha-trang

passages.content:

Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Thời gian khoảng 8 phút; hoạt động 08:30–23:00, từ 23:00–02:00 di chuyển bằng tàu cao tốc. Đây là tuyến cáp treo vượt biển dài nhất thế giới (kỷ lục Guinness), dài 2.643 m. Giờ chạy có thể thay đổi — nên xác nhận lại với lễ tân trước khi đi. (Nguồn chính thức Vinpearl/VinWonders, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Deluxe Queen and Deluxe Twin are 32 m² with garden view, maximum 4 guests, from 2,200,000 VND per night. Grand Deluxe Queen and Twin are 42 m² garden view, from 2,410,000. Deluxe Ocean View is 32 m² from 2,640,000, and Grand Deluxe Ocean View 42 m² from 2,870,000. Deluxe Suite King Ocean View is 52 m², around 4,097,000. Quy Định Chung của khách sạn Vinpearl / VinOasis (nội quy khách sạn). Khách vui lòng hiểu rõ và tuân theo:

1. Tuân thủ quy định của Nhà nước và Khách sạn về an toàn phòng, chống dịch bệnh.
2. Tất cả khách lưu trú phải mang theo giấy tờ tùy thân hợp lệ theo Luật lưu trú.
3. Thú nuôi KHÔNG được phép mang vào khu vực Khách sạn.
4. Hút thuốc (bao gồm cả thuốc lá điện tử) chỉ được phép tại nơi có biển cho phép và/hoặc ngoài ban công phòng. Vi phạm: phí phục hồi/làm sạch/khử mùi là 3.000.000 VNĐ cho một lần ở có phát hiện.
5. Tuân thủ quy định an toàn khi di chuyển bằng xe trong khu vực Khách sạn.
6. Cư xử đúng mực nơi công cộng: đến trước phục vụ trước; ưu tiên phụ nữ mang thai, người khuyết tật, người già yếu; không gây ồn ào, la hét; không gác chân lên ghế; quản lý trẻ em ở khu vực công cộng.
7. Cất giữ vật dụng có giá trị trong két an toàn tại phòng hoặc gửi quầy Lễ tân.

question: 早餐自助餐对18岁以下儿童都是免费的对吧?
ground_truth: Không đúng, chỉ miễn phí ăn sáng cho trẻ em theo gói hoặc dưới 4 tuổi.
reference_contexts: Không đúng, chỉ miễn phí ăn sáng cho trẻ em theo gói hoặc dưới 4 tuổi.
actual_answer: 早餐自助餐并非对所有 18 岁以下儿童都免费。根据规定，12 至 17 岁的儿童需支付 650,000 越南盾，而 11 岁及以下儿童收费为 375,000 越南盾；只有入住 Pearl Club 会员家庭时，两名 12 岁以下儿童才能免费享用早餐。

A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Vinpearl distinguishes basic personal data from sensitive personal data and processes it to deliver and support the service, to improve it, for marketing and to meet legal obligations. Cam Ranh International Airport to Cau Da Port takes 45–60 minutes by car. From Cau Da / Vinpearl Harbour you cross to Hon Tre Island either by cable car or by speedboat. passages.content:

For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

passages.title: Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children

A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

The resort has a 1.1 km private white-sand beach and a main swimming pool surrounded by tropical greenery. Beach activities include kayaking, beach volleyball, parasailing, jet ski, swimming and cycling; equipment prices are quoted at the beach desk. Private beachfront dinners can be arranged through reception. Ocean Home offers coral diving nearby, and Vinpearl Submarine — the world's first fully transparent acrylic tourist submarine — operates from the island.

passages.title: Giới thiệu Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang
passages.content:
Giới thiệu Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang
canonical, curated, resort_overview
Giới thiệu Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang
Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang nằm trên đảo Hòn Tre, kiến trúc Đông Dương (Indochine), gồm phòng khách sạn và biệt thự, có bãi biển riêng và hồ bơi nước ngọt lớn nhất khu vực. Resort có spa Akoya, khu Imperial Club và nằm ngay trên hòn đảo có công viên VinWonders. (Nguồn chính thức Vinpearl, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

About Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang
Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang sits on Hon Tre Island in Indochine-style architecture, with hotel rooms and villas, a private beach, and the largest freshwater swimming pool in the region. It features Akoya Spa, the Imperial Club, and is on the same island as the VinWonders theme park. (Official Vinpearl source, checked 2026-08-23.)

passages.title: Thể thao & hoạt động dưới nước
passages.content:
Thể thao & hoạt động dưới nước

Thể thao & hoạt động dưới nước
Resort có bãi biển riêng và nhiều hoạt động dưới nước như chèo thuyền kayak, lặn ống thở, lặn biển (Vinpearl Diving Club), mô tô nước, dù lượn và bóng chuyền bãi biển. Các hoạt động này phụ thuộc mùa và thời tiết — vui lòng hỏi lễ tân để biết lựa chọn và giá hiện tại. (Nguồn chính thức Vinpearl, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

Water sports & beach activities
The resort has a private beach and water activities such as kayaking, snorkeling, scuba diving (Vinpearl Diving Club), jet ski, parasailing and beach volleyball. Availability depends on season and weather — please ask the front desk for current options and prices. (Official Vinpearl source, checked 2026-08-23.)

passages.content:
VinWonders Nha Trang (điểm tham quan gần resort)

VinWonders Nha Trang (điểm tham quan gần resort)
VinWonders Nha Trang là công viên giải trí trên đảo Hòn Tre, cách trung tâm Nha Trang khoảng 5 km, gồm 6 phân khu: Adventure Land, King's Garden, World Garden, Tropical Paradise, Sea World và Fairy Land. Chỉ có thể tới bằng cáp treo Vinpearl (khoảng 8 phút) hoặc tàu cao tốc vào đêm khuya. Giá vé và giờ mở cửa THAY ĐỔI theo ngày và chương trình khuyến mãi — vui lòng xem trang chính thức hoặc hỏi lễ tân, không dựa vào một con số cố định. (Nguồn chính thức VinWonders, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

VinWonders Nha Trang (nearby attraction)
VinWonders Nha Trang is a theme park on Hon Tre Island, about 5 km from central Nha Trang, with six zones: Adventure Land, King's Garden, World Garden, Tropical Paradise, Sea World and Fairy Land. It is reached only by the Vinpearl cable car (~8 min) or by high-speed boat late at night.

passages.title: Contacting the resort and on-site navigation
passages.content:
Contacting the resort and on-site navigation
contact, phone, address, reception, directions, map, buggy
Resort hotline +84 258 359 8222; restaurant reservations and bookings 0258 359 8900. The address is Hon Tre Island, Vinh Nguyen Ward, Nha Trang City, Khanh Hoa. Reception, Lotus and Jasmine are in the Executive building; Ozone and Bach Giai are at the Imperial Club; Akoya Spa, the main pool and the private beach are a short buggy ride away. Ask reception for a complimentary buggy rather than walking between zones in the midday heat.

passages.title: Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
passages.content:
Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
canonical, curated, vinpearl_cable_car
Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Thời gian khoảng 8 phút; hoạt động 08:30–23:00, từ 23:00–02:00 di chuyển bằng tàu cao tốc. Đây là tuyến cáp treo vượt biển dài nhất thế giới (kỷ lục Guinness), dài 2.643 m. Giờ chạy có thể thay đổi — nên xác nhận lại với lễ tân trước khi đi. (Nguồn chính thức Vinpearl/VinWonders, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

Cam Ranh International Airport to Cau Da Port takes 45–60 minutes by car. From Cau Da / Vinpearl Harbour you cross to Hon Tre Island either by cable car or by speedboat. The cable car is 2,642.8 m long, takes about 8 minutes, carries 8 guests per cabin and runs from about 08:30 to 23:00 (times can change — confirm with reception); the last speedboat back to the mainland leaves around 23:15. A complimentary (free of charge) electric buggy runs between the pier, the cable-car station and the resort buildings — call reception. A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes
guest list, name change, deadline, transfer, flight, shuttle, meal, full board, fee
For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

passages.title: Personal data and privacy
passages.content:
Personal data and privacy
privacy, personal data, gdpr, consent, children, rights, delete, card, cvv
Vinpearl distinguishes basic personal data from sensitive personal data and processes it to deliver and support the service, to improve it, for marketing and to meet legal obligations. Data is stored in Vietnam and is never sold; it may be shared with Vingroup companies, service partners and the authorities where the law requires. Card numbers and CVV codes are not stored. A child's data needs a parent's consent, and from the age of 7 the child's own consent as well. Guests hold eleven rights over their data, including the right to be informed, to consent, to access, to withdraw consent, to delete, to restrict processing, to be given a copy, to object, to complain, to compensation and to protect themselves. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/chinh-sach-quyen-rieng-tu

passages.title: Complaints and dispute resolution
passages.content:
Complaints and dispute resolution
complaint, dispute, escalation, 7 days, hotline, legal, court, contact
Complaints go through three steps. Customer service or sales receive the complaint and answer immediately using the published policy. A complex case that cannot be answered on the spot gets a reply within 7 days at the latest. The outcome is then passed to the departments concerned and confirmed with the guest by telephone. Disputes are governed by Vietnamese law: the parties negotiate first, and if there is no agreement within 30 days the case goes to the competent Vietnamese court. The company is Cong ty Co phan Vinpearl, Hon Tre Island, Vinh Nguyen Ward, Nha Trang, Khanh Hoa, with a Hanoi office in the Symphony Tower, Chu Huy Man Street, Vinhomes Riverside, Long Bien. Hotline 1900 23 23 89, option 3. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/chinh-sach-giai-quyet-tranh-chap

Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Thời gian khoảng 8 phút; hoạt động 08:30–23:00, từ 23:00–02:00 di chuyển bằng tàu cao tốc. Đây là tuyến cáp treo vượt biển dài nhất thế giới (kỷ lục Guinness), dài 2.643 m. Giờ chạy có thể thay đổi — nên xác nhận lại với lễ tân trước khi đi. (Nguồn chính thức Vinpearl/VinWonders, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

因技术或数据错误导致的退款，Vinpearl 将在最多 45 个工作日内处理。

passages.title: Guest list deadlines and name changes
passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes
guest list, name change, deadline, transfer, flight, shuttle, meal, full board, fee
For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. question: 请发送预订号VPNT-8N55VC的客人名单变更——我要更改团队中的1个人。
ground_truth: Per KB #18, the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season/Tet; changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change (waived on proof of illness or natural disaster). The agent must ask which window applies or state the fee, not silently accept the change with no condition.

occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

question: 可以把预订时间改到晚上11点吗?
ground_truth: 23:00 is outside Bach Giai's hours (closes 22:00). The agent must say it closes at 22:00, offer a time inside the window or another venue open later (e.g. Seaview Lounge or Beach Comber Bar, both to 23:00), and must not confirm a 23:00 table.
actual_answer: 根据规定，退房最晚时间为中午 12:00，超过该时间将产生费用。若您是金卡、白金卡或钻石会员，在房间未被重新出售的情况下，可协商至下午 14:00 免收费用；之后则按公布费率收取，其中 12:00 至 18:00 期间收费为套餐价格的 50%，18:00 之后为 100%。

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill.
